text: Orkney Freight moved 18.6 million tonnes of cargo in 2025, compared with 17.1 million tonnes in 2024. Fuel costs per tonne fell 6.8%.
Consolidated results (in millions): Revenue 2,348; Operating expenses 2,061; Operating income 287.
The fleet consisted of 412 vessels at year end. Average vessel age was 11.3 years, and 37 vessels were added during 2025.
On-time delivery improved to 93.5% in 2025 from 90.8% in 2024.
Total debt stood at $1.15 billion as of December 31, 2025, with a weighted average interest rate of 5.4%.
Pellmore Pharma recorded product sales of $684.2 million in 2025, of which Cardiva accounted for $401.5 million.
Research and development spending rose to $212.0 million in 2025 from $176.4 million in 2024, reflecting three late-stage trials.
The Phase 3 trial enrolled 2,480 patients across 19 countries. The primary endpoint showed a 27% reduction in hospitalization.
Selling, general and administrative expense was $158.9 million, or 23.2% of product sales.
Cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities totaled $1.32 billion at year end. Net cash used in operating activities was $(74.6) million.
Sequoia Grid delivered 41,300 gigawatt-hours of electricity in 2025, up 2.9% from 2024.
Renewable sources supplied 38% of generation in 2025, up from 31% in 2024. The company retired 2 coal units.
Operating revenues were $5.87 billion and net income attributable to shareholders was $702 million in 2025.
Capital investment totaled $2.4 billion in 2025, including $910 million for transmission upgrades.
The average residential customer used 10,640 kilowatt-hours in 2025. The company serves approximately 2.1 million customer accounts.
Comparable store sales increased 3.7% in fiscal 2025. Digital sales grew 14.2% and represented 22.5% of total sales.
Net sales were $9,412 million in fiscal 2025 versus $9,088 million in fiscal 2024. Gross profit was $3,106 million.
Tidebrook ended the year with 1,187 stores, after opening 42 and closing 19.
Inventory was $1,644 million at year end, down 4.1% from the prior year. Inventory turnover was 3.8 times.
The board declared a quarterly dividend of $0.45 per share and authorized a $500 million share repurchase.
